verdict.rationale: Context.dev is a web scraping and extraction API, so PII detection and redaction of scraped content is a fair axis for this kind of product. However, no evidence documents any PII detection, redaction, or filtering capability. The people-enrichment endpoint is the opposite of this capability, and CSS-selected fields and JSON Schema extraction are adjacent building blocks, not automatic PII filtering.

support.subject: As a data-engineer, I can automatically detect and filter personally identifiable information out of scraped content before it reaches storage
